articles.title: Rays resting and waiting to see if they play Guardians or White Sox
articles.description: A taxed and tired opponent will show up at the Trop for Monday’s ALCS opener. The Rays should be ready with four days off.

articles.title: Key to Rays’ ALDS sweep? Starters making their pitch in various roles
articles.description: Though only three were needed to start games, all five members of the rotation pitched key innings in beating the Yankees.

articles.title: Florida notables cheer Rays’ ALDS win on social media
articles.description: Tampa Bay swept the series with a 4-3 win against the Yankees in Game 3.

articles.title: Once obscure outfielders, Victor Mesa Jr., Ryan Vilade power Rays’ sweep
articles.description: Vilade delivers a home run in the fourth inning while Mesa follows suit in the sixth.

articles.title: Rays celebrate in New York again with sweep of Yankees, advance to ALCS
articles.description: They will face the Guardians or White Sox starting Monday at Tropicana Field, with a berth in the World Series at stake.

articles.title: Fan-interference call eliminates Yankees’ tying home run vs. Rays
articles.description: Anthony Volpe’s shot is ruled a run-scoring double instead in the sixth inning.

articles.title: Kevin Cash’s changes to Rays lineup vs. Yankees’ Max Fried prove pivotal
articles.description: Right-hander Ryan Vilade, who hits well vs. lefties, starts in rightfield; lefty swinger Victor Mesa Jr. moves to left.

articles.title: New Tampa Bay Rays ‘experience center’ will offer first glimpse at the ballpark
articles.description: Fans and investors can stop by in person to learn more about the forthcoming Rays baseball stadium development.

articles.title: Nick Martinez ‘fully aware what’s at stake’ as he takes mound vs. Yankees
articles.description: Notes | Though the veteran right-hander made eight previous playoff appearances with the Padres and Reds, Game 3 will be his first start.

articles.title: With 2-0 ALDS lead, Rays are ready to celebrate again at Yankee Stadium
articles.description: Two weeks ago, they strolled into the Bronx and left with the AL East title. Now there’s a bigger prize at stake — the chance to play for a berth in the World Series.

articles.title: Rays do what they do well, lead Yankees 2-0 in AL Division Series
articles.description: A four-run rally in the fifth inning includes three hits, three softly hit balls and the usual hustle and havoc on the bases.

articles.title: See images from Game 2 of AL Division Series between Rays and Yankees
articles.description: Photo gallery | Tampa Bay moves within one win of clinching the best-of-five series.

articles.title: Rays plan to start Nick Martinez in ALDS Game 3 at Yankee Stadium
articles.description: Notes | The veteran had a strong season overall but was notably better on the road, which seemed to be a factor in the decision.

articles.title: Schlittler says Yankees will feel like they’re ‘playing at home’ at Trop
articles.description: Notes | The starter will take the mound for Game 2 on Monday expecting “a lot of Yankees fans” to be in the Tropicana Field stands.

articles.title: ‘King’ Freddy Peralta ready to reward Rays’ faith in ALDS Game 2 start
articles.description: A trade from the Mets created an opportunity for the veteran pitcher to return to his past All-Star form, and he took full advantage.

articles.title: This Rays-Yankees clash brings back memories of, and for, Mike Brosseau
articles.description: Tales | After being thrown at by Aroldis Chapman in September 2020, sparking a Kevin Cash rant, the Rays infielder swatted back with a key homer in the ALDS.

articles.title: Drew Rasmussen no-hits Yankees into 8th inning, Rays win ALDS opener
articles.description: The ace right-hander had thrown six no-hit innings against the Yankees in his previous outing on Sept. 22 in New York.
